visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Stacking With z-index
visualizerParams.description: Type two overlapping boxes where the second one is on top. For a z-index to work, the boxes must be positioned, and the higher number is drawn in front.

checks.label: The boxes overlap
checks.expr: (() => { var a = el('.red').getBoundingClientRect(), b = el('.blue').getBoundingClientRect(); return b.left < a.right && b.top < a.bottom; })()

checks.label: The red box is in front where they overlap
checks.expr: (() => { var a = el('.red').getBoundingClientRect(); return document.elementFromPoint(a.right - 5, a.bottom - 5) === el('.red'); })()
